body:
GitHub issue #329.

## Problem

`scripts/mutation-gate.mjs` `main()` builds its changed-file set with
`git diff --name-only -z <base>` (line 238), which INCLUDES deleted files. A
deleted source file still matches the source predicate
(`hollowTestWouldMutate` -> `isMutableSource`, purely path-based), so
`classify()` places it in the eligible set and returns `kind: 'fast'`. The
wrapper then invokes hollow-test, which mutates files IN PLACE and finds the
file is gone:

    mutation-gate: 1 file(s) covered by fast test targets -> node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs
    error: nothing to mutate - the diff contains no eligible source files
    (only test/spec/non-code files changed).

Exit 1. CI runs the gate identically
(`.github/workflows/ci.yml:335`, no `--target`), so ANY deletion-only PR -
every dead-code removal - fails the required mutation-gate check. Discovered
removing dead code under #307 (T73).

## Required behavior

A deletion (or a rename's old path) has no on-disk post-image; hollow-test
cannot mutate it. Exclude such paths from the set the wrapper feeds `classify`,
in `main()` at the git-diff step, so a deletion-only diff classifies as
`kind: 'nothing'` and exits 0 - agreeing with hollow-test's own behavior (it
also finds nothing), so no new wrapper/tool source-classification drift is
introduced.

Keep `classify()` PURE over path strings: its existing unit tests deliberately
pass non-existent source paths (e.g. `packages/foo/lib/x.mjs` with an empty
fixture) and expect `fast`/`slow`. Do NOT add source-file existence checks
inside `classify()` - that would break those tests and the pure-classification
contract. The deletion filter belongs at the git-diff boundary in `main()`.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `main()` excludes deleted paths from the changed set before `classify`
   (e.g. `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d`). Verify by reading main().
2. A regression test reproduces #329: a temp git repo whose HEAD diff is the
   deletion of a mutable source file (plus only test/non-source files) runs the
   gate and exits 0 with a 'nothing to mutate' classification - NOT exit 1.
   Verify: the test is RED against the pre-fix command and GREEN after.
3. `classify()` is unchanged and its existing unit tests still pass (the
   pure-over-path-strings contract, incl. the non-existent-path fixtures, is
   preserved). Verify: scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs green.
4. A normal diff that ADDS/MODIFIES a mutable source file is unaffected - still
   classified fast/slow and still mutated. Verify by an existing or added case.
5. Full mutation-gate segment green and `npm run preflight` green.

## Constraints

- Do NOT change `isMutableSource` / `hollowTestWouldMutate` / the SOURCE_GLOBS
  drift contract - the danger direction the wrapper guards against (wrapper says
  not-source while hollow-test mutates) must stay closed.
- Do NOT weaken coverage of added/modified source; only remove deletions, which
  are genuinely unmutatable.
title: mutation-gate: exclude deleted files from the changed set — deletion-only diffs must not hard-fail
